def solve(g):
    H_,W_=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*W_ for _ in range(H_)]
    def is_ring(cells):
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        return len(cells)==2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4 and r1>r0+1 and c1>c0+1
    sh=shapes(g)
    rings=[s_ for s_ in sh if is_ring(s_[6])]
    crosses=[s_ for s_ in sh if not is_ring(s_[6])]
    # rings top-anchored, input order by top row; collision: shift below
    placed=[]
    for s_ in sorted(rings,key=lambda s_:s_[1]):
        cells=s_[6]; h=s_[2]-s_[1]+1; c0=s_[3]
        top=0
        while True:
            oc={(r_-s_[1]+top,c_-c0) for (r_,c_) in cells}
            bad=any((r_ in range(H_) and c_ in range(W_) and out[r_][c_]) for r_,c_ in oc)
            bad|= any(oc & {(r_-p[1]+q[1], c_-p[3]+q[3]) for q in pc} for p,pc in placed)
            # simpler: check against placed via absolute coords
            bad=False
            for r_,c_ in oc:
                if not(0<=r_<H_ and 0<=c_<W_) or out[r_][c_]: bad=True
            if not bad: break
            top+=1
        for (r_,c_) in cells:
            out[r_-s_[1]+top][c_]=s_[0]
        placed.append(s_)
    # crosses bottom-anchored, per-column-cluster stacking: process by input order; place bottom; if overlap with placed cross, shift up to clear
    for s_ in sorted(crosses,key=lambda s_:s_[1]):
        cells=s_[6]; h=s_[2]-s_[1]+1
        bot=H_-1
        while True:
            oc={(r_-s_[2]+bot,c_) for (r_,c_) in cells}
            if any(r_<0 or out[r_][c_] for r_,c_ in oc): bot-=1; continue
            break
        for (r_,c_) in cells: out[r_-s_[2]+bot][c_]=s_[0]
    return out
